task.description: Implement OIDC-02 per src/design/oidc-02-keycloak-adapter.md. Add the concrete Keycloak 26.x adapter that satisfies the OIDC-01 IdentityProvider contract while keeping all Keycloak-specific URLs, payloads, DTOs, and behavior isolated to the adapter package. Preserve compile isolation so non-adapter modules remain decoupled from Keycloak-specific imports or types. Add or update tests needed to prove adapter conformance and compile-isolation expectations, then run the mandatory backend validation commands.
acceptance_criteria: Keycloak adapter implements the OIDC-01 provider contract with Keycloak-specific concerns isolated to adapter modules
Non-adapter auth/provider modules do not depend on Keycloak-specific URLs, payloads, or types
Build/test/migrate validations pass per backend workflow requirements
OIDC-02 acceptance criteria are covered by tests or verifiable compile-isolation assertions

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-02 by adding a concrete Keycloak adapter package that satisfies the OIDC-01 IdentityProvider contract while keeping Keycloak URLs, request/response mapping, and admin semantics isolated under the adapter. Restored compile isolation by removing the shared provider root's Keycloak re-export and added focused tests covering adapter conformance plus build-isolation expectations.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for OIDC-02 traceability and downstream coverage planning.
